desc: Ideation: identify right-end sweep with top-two active left endpoints for exclusive gain.
Implement Solution.maxSubarrays using the right-end sweep with grouped equal b values, top-two active a tracking, total_invalid accumulation, and per-pair exclusive delta.
Validate against provided examples, edge cases (m = 1, duplicate pairs, same b, same a, tied maxima), random brute-force checks, and large n performance.
